_note: Photos of Costa Rica that sit beside the studio's own images on town, cost and land pages. Unsplash or Pexels licence (no credit required; the credits stay here, not on the page), or Wikimedia Commons: a photo with `license` (CC BY or BY-SA) is credited where it shows, under the photo on a town's and a cost page and in the sources line of where we work. `towns` maps each town to a photo, or to one of our projects there as "project:<slug>/<n>". scripts/places.py crops each to a 2:1 band around 'focus' (0 top, 1 bottom) and writes site/assets/img/places/<id>-{1600,800}.webp. The alt text says what the photo shows, never that it is the town it illustrates.
